stem: Which component is called the brain of the computer?
explanation: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) performs all processing and controls the other units, so it is called the brain of the computer.

stem: Which of the following is a volatile memory?
explanation: RAM loses its contents when power is switched off, so it is volatile. ROM, SSD and hard disks retain data without power.

stem: 1 GB is equal to how many megabytes (MB)?
explanation: In binary units, 1 GB = 2¹⁰ MB = 1024 MB.

stem: Which of the following is NOT an operating system?
explanation: Windows, Linux and Ubuntu are operating systems. Oracle is a database management system, not an OS.

stem: The binary number 1010 is equal to which decimal number?
The hexadecimal number 1F is equal to which decimal number?
Which service translates human-readable domain names such as www.example.com into IP addresses?
explanation: DNS (Domain Name System) resolves domain names to the corresponding IP addresses. FTP transfers files, SMTP sends mail and HTTP serves web pages.

stem: Which network device is used to connect two different networks and forward data between them?
explanation: A router forwards data packets between different networks (for example, a home network and the internet). Switches and hubs work within one network; a repeater only regenerates signals.

stem: The OSI reference model divides network communication into how many layers?
explanation: The OSI model has 7 layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation and Application.

stem: In a relational database, which key uniquely identifies each row of a table?
explanation: The primary key uniquely identifies every row of a table and cannot contain duplicates or nulls. A foreign key instead references a key in another table.

stem: Which SQL command is used to retrieve data from a database table?
explanation: SELECT fetches rows from a table. INSERT adds rows, UPDATE modifies them and DELETE removes them.

stem: Which of the following is a NoSQL database?
explanation: MongoDB is a document-oriented NoSQL database. MySQL, PostgreSQL and Oracle are relational (SQL) database systems.

stem: Which translator converts an entire high-level program into machine code before execution?
explanation: A compiler translates the whole program at once into machine code before it runs; an interpreter instead executes it line by line. Debuggers and loaders do not translate source code.

stem: The worst-case time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements is —
explanation: Binary search halves the search space with every comparison, so it needs at most O(log n) comparisons even in the worst case.

stem: Which data structure is used to implement breadth-first search (BFS) of a graph?
explanation: BFS visits vertices level by level using a queue (First-In, First-Out). A stack is used for depth-first search.

stem: What does the HTTP status code 404 indicate?
explanation: 404 means the requested resource was not found on the server. 500 is Internal Server Error, 401 is Unauthorized and 301 is Moved Permanently.

stem: A login form must send the password in the request body rather than in the URL. Which form method attribute should be used?
explanation: POST submits the form data in the request body, so it does not appear in the URL (or in browser history). GET appends data to the URL as query parameters.

stem: In an operating system, a deadlock occurs when —
options: a process runs forever in an infinite loop
two programs open the same file simultaneously
a program waits for the user to press a key
two or more processes wait indefinitely for resources held by each other
explanation: A deadlock is a state in which each process holds a resource the others need, so all of them wait forever and none can proceed.

stem: Phishing is best described as —
options: a fraudulent attempt to obtain sensitive information by impersonating a trusted entity
a virus that encrypts files and demands payment
a technique to speed up network traffic
a method of physically stealing a computer
explanation: Phishing uses fake emails, messages or websites that imitate trusted organisations to trick users into revealing passwords, card numbers or other sensitive data.

stem: In the memory hierarchy of a computer, which cache is typically the fastest and closest to the CPU?
explanation: L1 cache sits inside the CPU core and is the smallest and fastest cache; L2 and L3 are progressively larger and slower, and RAM is slower still.

stem: Choose the word most similar in meaning to “candid”.
explanation: “Candid” means honest and straightforward, i.e. frank. It does not mean rude, cunning or shy.

stem: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to “transparent”.
explanation: “Transparent” means that light passes through so objects behind can be seen; its opposite is “opaque”, through which one cannot see.

stem: One who is indifferent to pleasure and pain is called —
explanation: A stoic endures pleasure and pain without showing feeling. An epicurean seeks pleasure, a cynic questions others' motives, and an optimist expects the best.

stem: The idiom “to spill the beans” means —
explanation: “To spill the beans” means to reveal secret information, usually unintentionally.

stem: Choose the correct form: “Neither of the two candidates ___ qualified.”
explanation: “Neither of” takes a singular verb, so “was” is correct: neither (one) of the two candidates was qualified.

stem: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?
options: One of my friend is a doctor.
One of my friends are a doctor.
One of my friends is a doctor.
One of my friend are a doctor.
explanation: “One of” must be followed by a plural noun (“friends”) and a singular verb (“is”), because the subject is “one”.

stem: Choose the correct form: “The number of applicants ___ increasing every year.”
explanation: The subject here is “the number” (singular), not “applicants”, so the singular verb “is” is correct. Note the contrast with “a number of applicants are…”, where the subject is plural.

stem: Which version of the sentence is correct?
options: He is more senior than me.
explanation: Latin comparatives such as senior, junior, superior and inferior take “to”, not “than”: “He is senior to me.”

Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928 quite by accident. A petri dish containing staphylococci had been left uncovered, and a mould grew on it. Fleming noticed a clear halo around the mould where the bacteria had been destroyed. He identified the antibacterial substance produced by the mould and named it penicillin. Although Fleming could not purify it in usable quantities, Howard Florey and Ernst Chain later succeeded in mass-producing it during the 1940s, saving millions of lives.

Question: According to the passage, what did Fleming observe on the petri dish?
options: The mould had killed the entire colony of staphylococci
The bacteria had grown over the mould
A clear halo around the mould where the bacteria had been destroyed
The dish had been contaminated by penicillin from another experiment
explanation: The passage states that Fleming noticed “a clear halo around the mould where the bacteria had been destroyed”. The other options go beyond or contradict the passage.
